summary: Selects a global value by an integer selector: selector 0 returns dword_5BF8C8, selector 1 returns dword_5BF8D0, and any other selector value returns -1. Pure read-only dispatch with no side effects.

local_names.selector: a1 parameter selecting which global is returned

operations.description: If a1 is 0, return the value of global dword_5BF8C8.
If a1 is 1, return the value of global dword_5BF8D0.
For any a1 other than 0 or 1, return the default value -1.

unresolved: What dword_5BF8C8 and dword_5BF8D0 represent (e.g. cached font/character render state selected by the caller FontCharacterRenderDispatcher) is not established by the packet.
Why non-matching selectors return -1 (sentinel/error) vs a default value is unknown.
The two globals are close in address space; whether they are distinct fields or array elements of a single object is not resolvable from this function alone.
